title: tag_resolve
description: See docs/links.md. The app read a tag link (NFC, QR or opened link) and asks the hub what the tag does. The hub answers tag_result, logs tag_scanned (activity, <ns>_event and <ns>_tag_scanned in Home Assistant) and never executes anything itself: the app switches afterwards like a widget (control_origin quick_access). At most 10 per minute per device (rate_limited).

via.description: How the app got the link (log only). Missing = link.
